blends.name: The Gyrating Hips
blends.desc:
Twitch Live - The Gyrating Hips
•
This pre-minted blend is for one of five possible rarities of the new neon burn street sign.
•
Possible Rarity odds:
•
Lit 54% - 60 max mints
Glow 27% - 30 max mints
Neon 13.5% - 15 max mints
Naked 4.5% - 5 max mints
Shine 0.9% - 1 of 1 
•
The cost of this blend is 2 Neon Blend tokens to roll the RNG dice for one mint. Good luck and happy blending.

blends.name: Be My Victim
blends.desc:
Be My Victim - Burn Street blend
​
This mint on demand blend is for one of three possible rarities of the new neon burn street sign.
​
Possible Rarity odds:
​
Lit 66% - 150 max mints
Glow 22% - 50 max mints
Neon 11% - 25 max mints
​
The max mint displayed on the template will have to be unlimited in order for us to make a mint on demand blend but we will close the contract when it either sells out or is retired. 

The cost of this blend is 2 Neon Blend tokens to roll the RNG dice for one mint. Good luck and happy blending.

blends.name: FTXmas
blends.desc:
Naked Blend.

Burn 1 [Neon Blend Token NFT](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/neonspacenft/336012) for the RNG chance at one of 2 Naked Neon artworks!

The possible outcomes for this blend are:

FTXmas - Naked (50 total mint)

FTXmas - Shine (5 total mint)

All blends are preminted.

28 blends will be available at 2:15PM PT and 27 more will be available at 8:15PM PT.
